claims.text:
8. collaborative-filtering

Target / packet: ai-collaborative-filtering · R1. Prerequisites: ai:cosine-similarity.

Nearest / distinct payoff: cosine-similarity → direction-not-distance. Cosine similarity alone measures vectors; this derives a recommendation from other users’ interaction rows without item content.

Finite primary model: Binary user-item rows U 1=[1,1,0], U 2=[1,0,1], U 3=[0,1,1]. Cosine similarity U 1 to U 2/U 3=.5 each. Predict unconsumed item C using normalized neighbor-weighted interactions: (.51+.51)/1=1.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: If U 3 C changes 0, its row[0,1,0] has similarity 1/sqrt 2 and prediction C=.5/(.5+1/sqrt 2)≈.414214. No content features used. Interaction 1 is observed binary engagement, not a known preference or causal recommendation effect.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict score C after changing U 3; recall why this mechanism depends on other users' co-interactions rather than item meaning.

Required observable evidence: Show only 3 users×3 items and explicit cosine normalization; absent interactions are 0 inthis constructed complete matrix.

Source obligation: Declared local finite model. Exact results require independent arithmetic reproduction; this construction supports no real-model performance or universal improvement claim. Method-source obligations remain as listed in the acquisition record below.
